TUTO_Welcome.en: Welcome to the Yokai Night Market!

TUTO_Obj.zh: 比隔壁先备好摊位，就算赢。
TUTO_Obj.en: Get your stall ready before the rival to win.

TUTO_Para.zh:
双方各抽一份委托。
数字左边是已做的，右边是要做的。
TUTO_Para.en:
Each stall draws an order.
The left number is work done; the right is work needed.

TUTO_Turno.zh:
轮到你时，先自动修补、让帮工干活，再补牌。
接着可以连续出牌，准备好了就结束本轮。
TUTO_Turno.en:
Your turn starts with repairs, helper work and a draw.
Then play your cards and end the turn when ready.

TUTO_Cada.zh:
帮工干两轮或四轮，做完一项就离岗。
本轮先招哪个岗位，后面就只能招这个岗位。
TUTO_Cada.en:
Helpers finish one task in two or four turns, then leave.
The first helper hired sets the department for this turn.

TUTO_Termina.zh:
招客、备餐、备货、挂灯、布符，五栏都做够就开摊。
哪边先做够，哪边立刻获胜。
TUTO_Termina.en:
Complete the guests, food, supplies, lanterns and wards.
The first stall to meet all five goals wins immediately.

TUTO2_Dev.zh: 帮工：到自己摊位干活，做完一项就离岗。
TUTO2_Dev.en: Helpers finish a task at your stall, then leave.

TUTO2_Neg.zh: 闹场让隔壁停工；挖角可以带走隔壁的帮工。
TUTO2_Neg.en: Trouble stops rival work. Interventions move rival helpers.

TUTO2_Pos.zh: 搭把手：帮着赶工、完工，或减少要做的事。
TUTO2_Pos.en: Helping hands advance or finish work, or reduce goals.

TUTO2_Esp.zh: 修补处理指定闹场；巡街倒计时内可以用调停。
TUTO2_Esp.en: Repairs fix listed trouble; mediators stop inspections.

TUTO2_Juega.zh: 点牌使用；空格或右键结束本轮，Tab 快进。
TUTO2_Juega.en: Click to play; Space/right-click: end turn; Tab: speed up.

TUTO2_Buena.en: Use a mediator before time runs out. Let's open the stall!

REASON_1.en: All five helper slots are occupied

REASON_2.zh: 本轮只能再招已选岗位的帮工
REASON_2.en: Hire from the department already chosen this turn

REASON_3.en: All rival trouble slots are occupied

REASON_4.en: The rival has no working helpers

REASON_5.en: The rival has no completed tasks

REASON_6.zh: 这位帮工正在隔壁干活

REASON_7.zh: 没有能继续干活的帮工

REASON_9.zh: 没有对应闹场，或已错过调停时机
REASON_9.en: No matching trouble, or the mediator window has closed

SubTitle1.zh: 灯先挂在巷口，晚来的客人才找得着。

SubTitle2.zh: 两位夜班客人说好了，收工来喝热汤。

SubTitle3.zh: 桥边风大，给等月亮的人留个背风位。

SubTitle4.zh: 旧货擦干净再摆，轻东西别让风卷跑。

SubTitle5.zh: 河雾又漫上来了，补好棚再搬货。

SubTitle6.zh: 衣服送来了，灯挂近一点才看得清针脚。

SubTitle7.zh: 小戏班今晚来，把台前那条路空出来。
SubTitle7.en: Clear a path for the troupe.

SubTitle8.zh: 伞骨修好，最后一位客人还要走远路。

SubTitle9.zh: 过了子时还有船，干粮包好，别沾河水。

SubTitle10.zh: 铃挂桥头，搬货的听见就知道往哪儿走。

SubTitle11.zh: 邻摊来借火，记得留一盆炭。

SubTitle12.zh: 狐狸们订了一桌，锅边多留几个矮凳。

SubTitle13.zh: 水摊摆在渡口，夜船一靠岸就看得见。

SubTitle14.zh: 篷布拉平，客人今晚就在月下坐。

SubTitle15.zh: 纸客怕吵，灯别太亮，帘子放下来。

SubTitle16.zh: 朋友们带着碗来了，再添几张凳子。

SubTitle17.zh: 桥边今晚有人守夜，留灯，也留一锅热的。
SubTitle17.en: Hot food for the night watch.

SubTitle18.zh: 柜子里还有没见过的旧货，一件件摆出来。

SubTitle19.zh: 末班船快到了，灯挂高些，别让人走错巷。
SubTitle19.en: A high lamp for the last boat.

SubTitle20.zh: 雨声正好，帘下摆两把椅子。
SubTitle20.en: Two chairs out of the rain.

SubTitle21.zh: 鼓队沿街走，摊前别堆货挡路。

SubTitle22.zh: 两把旧伞撑开，给约好的人留座。

SubTitle23.zh: 送灯的客人要过河，先把岸边照亮。

SubTitle24.zh: 小路通着荒坟，符绳系好，给行人留缝。
SubTitle24.en: Leave a gap in the ward rope.

SubTitle25.zh: 旧友们要来叙旧，大锅洗净，多备几个碗。

SubTitle26.zh: 秋风起了，布压住，旧货按轻重排。

SubTitle27.zh: 五条巷今晚一起开摊，各摊听见铃就准备。
SubTitle27.en: Five lanes open at the bell.

SubTitle28.zh: 摆在鬼门前，灯、汤和回去的路都要备好。
